purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (shinryo-hoshu seikyu) software - specifically Osaka/wide-area federation diagnosis report billing request (inner division) monthly aggregation print program
purpose.summary: SOKATU2705 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that aggregates and prints monthly billing request reports for the Osaka wide-area federation (Kochi-Rengo) insurer category. It reads receipt update files, accumulates counts and amounts by insurer/public-expense category, and writes formatted output records.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY copybooks (29 COPY statements) for record layouts
UNSTRING of COMMAND-PARAM for parameter passing
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM (called as subprogram or shell-invoked)
OCCURS tables for insurer and public-expense aggregation (SUM-KOH-TBL OCCURS 100, WRK-2007-TBL OCCURS 100)
REDEFINES clauses for hospital name/address splitting
No COMP-3 usage despite financial amounts
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese); decoded as latin-1 causing garbled comment text. Program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 81579 bytes (1978 lines total), but enough structure is visible for confident classification.
